test_first.current_failure_oracle: The replacement asserts the first actual scheduler process reports exactly one newly scheduled due source and that exactly one durable QUEUED operation exists. Disabling the scheduler tick/scheduling path makes these assertions fail. The second process must report ACTIVE_OPERATION with no new operation; the worker must complete it; the third tick must report NOT_DUE with no duplicate.
